215526.description:
The supreme prince of the Spirit Realm was tragically murdered after being plotted against, and reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant! Possessing an unparalleled creation elixir and heaven-defying cultivation techniques, he overturns the entire martial arts world with only a rusty sword. His dual martial souls awaken simultaneously, refining all spirits and comprehending the dual paths of divine soul cultivation. He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror. Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status. He confronts his two archenemies, Long Zhetian and Nangong Lingtian, tearing apart the long-buried conspiracy of ancient dark turmoil.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

215693.description:
Yuan Juntang and Li Shiya successfully joined hands, beginning the dream campus romance everyone had dreamed of. However, as the sweet filter gradually fades, feelings of inferiority, confusion, and growing pains arrive as expected. When passionate love collides with realistic dreams, they tug between compromise and being side by side, and this symphony of youth will ultimately face its final decision.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: こまどり モフモフパレード

215695.description:
A stop-motion spinoff of IDOLiSH7.

The project takes place "in a different world" from the main series, on a planet somewhere out in space. The Mofmof of the title are cute, fluffy aliens based on the 16 idols of the franchise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

215639.description: Faced with wealth that could last ten lifetimes, would you dare to gamble everything? Led by Lü Dongbin and Zhongli Quan, and joined by He Xiangu, Tieguai Li, Han Xiangzi, Cao Guojiu, Lan Caihe, and Zhang Guolao, eight mortals of diverse backgrounds have inadvertently come together in the Penglai Wonderland. Some acted on impulse, others joined instantly, and they impersonate immortals, engaging in various dangerous schemes in preparation for a big heist! A long-planned "immortality" scam has officially begun! Beneath the guise of fake immortals lies a burning ambition for sudden wealth; within the makeshift facade lies the audacity to deceive the heavens. Little did they know that a shocking conspiracy was quietly descending upon them. Where will this farcical and fantastical journey ultimately lead?

215791.description:
Armageddon—the final war between good and evil, to be waged at the end of the world. Its predetermined outcome was overturned. The desperate wish of those who “did not want to die”—that hopeless selfishness—empowered the evil god. Eight billion humans were sacrificed, and only a handful were allowed to survive—to be toyed with endlessly as the evil god’s playthings. The “Frashokereti” (Renewal of the World), which had been repeated countless times since the dawn of the universe, was shattered here for the first time.

The sun will never rise again.
In a world where reason has gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood.
Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon.

After countless sacrifices, the magicians devised a single spell. A forbidden ritual that transforms a girl’s blood into a blade capable of vanquishing demons.
Blood as a weapon. Life as a weapon. Humanity itself—the final weapon to resist the demons.
Chosen… Survivors… The strongest, cursed girls.
Blood-battle humans—.

The younger sister is the strongest blood-battle human, her soul stolen. The older sister was born unable to walk. Yet, she is the only one in this world—her blood alone can awaken the power of her slumbering sister.

Eva and Epica. Sisters bound by fate in the darkness of the apocalypse.
With their blood... strike down the demons that have defiled the world!

An original dark fantasy action series by Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM, and Polygon Pictures is here!

(Source: YouTube Description, translated)

215522.description:
Taoist Cui accidentally released the treasure-gathering golden toad in order to read the heavenly book. The golden toad coveted the prosperity of the human world and reincarnated as a human, Dou Zhanlong. In order to avoid the heavenly calamity, the golden toad tore the three souls and seven spirits in Dou Zhanlong's spiritual cavity, creating nine clones, which fell into nine places respectively. The nine Dou Zhanlongs were in different parallel time and space, and each death gave rise to a new clone. They experienced "nine deaths and thirteen disasters" in total. Our story starts with the first Dou Zhanlong.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

215106.description:
Here lies
Alain Guillotin
Founding Director of the Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering
White Cavalier of Protection
Lord-Artificer

May the waters protect his soul
May he be troubled by suffering no more
May the waters guide his soul

"Regrettably, there's nothing more to say."

215298.description:
Qin Aofeng, a modern mercenary, is reincarnated into a fantasy world overrun by magical beasts. Disguised as a man, she sheds her reputation as the "useless seventh young master" to transform into an unparalleled genius. Her journey spans across the Brilliance Continent, the Northern Exiled Lands, and the Continent of the Gods as she embarks on a quest to find her family and challenge the divine ranks.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: 傲风: 北境放逐之地

215521.description:
As heavy snow blanketed the gates, demonic cultivators launched a surprise attack, slaughtering the entire Mo Sect. The young Lu Chaoge lost his closest relatives in the tragedy. Facing certain death, he awakened to a system that defied the heavens, narrowly escaping death through water-elemental spiritual awakening, and vowed to purge the world of demons and evil. After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.

(Source: Yuewen, translated)

215297.description:
After transmigrating into a cyberpunk world, she defeated the BOSS and rose to the top.

Kui Xin was one of the lucky few to be selected to become a beta tester for an upcoming game, 'Crimson Earth'. A futuristic game with a mix of cyberpunk and lovecraft elements.

However, things soon took a wild turn after she realised she got transported into a parallel world where hyper intelligent AI monitors everyone's movement while playing the virtual game.

Supernatural beings, Cyborgs, Secret Cults, and Abnormal humans took the spotlight in this new world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: After Transmigrating into the Cyberpunk Game, I Defeated the BOSS and Successfully Rose to the Top

title.english: You and I Are Polar Opposites

215520.description: Little cats Miaomiao and Mimi are a pair of siblings with opposite personalities, one is hardworking and obedient, and the other is indulgent and lazy.  When the sun comes out, mom tells them to get up, and Miaomiao rolls up but Mimi is lazy and stays in bed; when washing their faces, Mimi starts playing a game of eating soap bubbles.  The family of three comes to the riverside to fish, Miaomiao sits by mom's side and focuses on fishing, but Mimi chases butterflies here and dragonflies there, and the end result is that mom and Miaomiao have a lot of fish in hand when they go home, but Mimi is empty-handed.  While sitting at the dining table and waiting for fish to eat, Miaomiao and Mimi get into an argument about fishing and eating fish, mom calms them down, and the kitties understand that fishing requires focus.

title.native: 天地ギャラクシー（パイロット版）

215969.description:
TENCHI GALAXY follows the Tenchi gang as they travel to the planet of the space pirates, MIKUNI, in search of an artifact that was stolen from Jurai. In order to get it back, they must face NIIMI, the queen of the space pirates. What dangers await them? What connection does Niimi have to Ryouko? And whose side is Nagi on?"

(Source: Official Kickstarter)

Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.

215989.description:
Based on the erotic game by Studio Pork.

Sunao Saiki, who had just moved into an apartment, was a student preparing for college entrance exams. He began his new life living alone with a somber expression. However, after meeting the wife of the couple next door and being captivated by her beauty, Sunao’s new life began to brighten up. “I’m Ayano Shinonome, your neighbor. Nice to meet you.” By chance, Sunao ended up working at the same part-time job as Ayano. As Ayano kindly looked out for him both at work and in the apartment, Sunao gradually found himself drawn to her. But she was a married woman. Sunao tried to hold back, yet his feelings were impossible to suppress, and he spent his days torn by inner conflict. At the same time, Ayano, too, began to see the likeness of her first love in Sunao and started to view him as a man… The memory of a first love, the warmth of a married woman. Separated by just a single wall, a dangerous romance begins to blossom.

(Source: Getchu, translated)
synonyms: Fallen Part-Time Wife: Succumbing to an Affair with a Younger Man
